dateSource: EXIF DateTimeOriginal read as camera-local time; all selected photographs record +01:00 (British Summer Time). UTC-looking Pixel filenames are not used as calendar dates.
locationNotes: Place labels use visible landmarks, signs and capture order. Most source images have no GPS; exact sites are named only when supported by visible evidence.
Reference pages support landmark naming; they are not itineraries or proof of a particular visit.
Exact coordinates, originals, travel documents and private references are not exported.
criteria: All 830 JPEGs reviewed in chronological contact sheets; shortlisted photographs reviewed again at 400-pixel contact-sheet size, with cover and representative exports checked separately.
Prefer distinct, sharp scenery, architecture, wildlife, food and daily life over repeated bursts and posed portraits.
The cover is selected once and is not repeated in a gallery.
Original framing and colour are preserved; EXIF orientation is corrected and EXIF/XMP metadata is omitted from web exports.

chapterCounts.location: Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum, Glasgow

omissionReasons: Near-identical bursts and duplicate copies, weak or obstructed views, screenshots, receipts and travel documents were omitted.
Conference slides, award certificates and logistical records were omitted from the travel essay.
Videos are outside this still-photo album.
Short days have fewer frames because the source collection contains fewer distinct suitable photographs.
18 August flight and destination photographs, including images with +02:00 offsets, are outside the Britain essay; only the Glasgow station farewell is selected that day.
